item.title: Seven-year-old American girl killed in Mexico; authorities investigate whether gunfire from a police helicopter was responsible
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Tamaulipas, Mexico. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Mexican police (under investigation). Reported casualties: 1 killed.
